input.summary: Delete the carve-out in Section 13.5 that transfers ownership of Corio-created Developments to Commerce One where Commerce One supports them on an ongoing basis.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the carve-out that would give Commerce One ownership of Developments created solely by Corio simply because Commerce One supports them on an ongoing basis, since we cannot assign our own IP to a vendor and there is no licence back. Commerce One's pre-existing materials and the Software itself remain its property under Sections 13.5 and 2.8; if ongoing support is the concern, we can instead grant Commerce One a licence to use and support those Developments.
